status: LINEAR sealed-box small-signal assumption, no motor nonlinearity, EQ, room, thermal losses or wall radiation
caveats: Effective volume = physical V+static panel volume-equivalent from simply supported Kirchhoff SSSS approximation; not a real volume change.
This approximation ignores panel dynamic mode resonance, its radiated sound, acoustic leakage and pressure-induced nonlinear distortion.
P35A 80Hz face-weighted result is only a static load sensitivity diagnostic, not a true frequency-dependent F3.
The P36A intact front model ignores cut-out; idealized two-line braces may dramatically exaggerate stiffness gains.
Drivers use published T/S from repository, not verified specimen measurements. No current amp DSP costs, efficiency, max SPL or THD.
Do not judge driver sound quality solely from F3 or Qtc.
